question: Where is the nearest restaurant situated on the way toward Best Western Plus Chain Of Lakes Inn & Suites, Leesburg, FL from Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue, FL?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.561715 28.411566)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.888211 28.829688)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.561715 28.411566)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.561715 28.411566)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Best Western Plus Chain Of Lakes Inn & Suites, Leesburg, FL

poi.poi_name: Best Western Plus Chain Of Lakes Inn & Suites
